package orderpub

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/segmentio/kafka-go"
	confkafka "github.com/confluentinc/confluent-kafka-go/v2/kafka"
)

// PublishOrder publishes an order.created event using segmentio/kafka-go.
func PublishOrder(ctx context.Context, w *kafka.Writer) error {
	return w.WriteMessages(ctx, kafka.Message{
		Topic: "order.created",
		Key:   []byte("k"),
		Value: []byte("v"),
	})
}

// MakeWriter constructs a Writer pinned to inventory.updated.
func MakeWriter() *kafka.Writer {
	return kafka.NewWriter(kafka.WriterConfig{
		Topic:   "inventory.updated",
		Brokers: []string{"broker:9092"},
	})
}

// MakeReader constructs a Reader pinned to user.signed_in.
func MakeReader() *kafka.Reader {
	return kafka.NewReader(kafka.ReaderConfig{
		Topic:   "user.signed_in",
		Brokers: []string{"broker:9092"},
	})
}

// PublishConfluent uses confluent-kafka-go's Producer API.
func PublishConfluent(p *confkafka.Producer) error {
	topic := "payment.captured"
	return p.Produce(&confkafka.Message{
		TopicPartition: confkafka.TopicPartition{Topic: &topic},
		Value:          []byte("v"),
	}, nil)
}

// SubscribeConfluent subscribes a confluent consumer to a single topic.
func SubscribeConfluent(c *confkafka.Consumer) error {
	return c.Subscribe("audit.events", nil)
}

// SubscribeMany subscribes to multiple topics.
func SubscribeMany(c *confkafka.Consumer) error {
	return c.SubscribeTopics([]string{"alpha.topic", "beta.topic"}, nil)
}
